escape_underscores option escapes underscores in plain text

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"escape_underscores\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>The variable_name is defined.</p>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
